prompt: Create an original 150 second instrumental funk instrumental composition for nature documentary, landscape and gentle exploration. Mood: organic, open, fresh. Instruments: clavinet, slap bass, tight drums, rhythm guitar. Style: sixteenth-note syncopation with short call-and-response riffs. Tempo approximately 110 BPM; D dorian. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Introduce a gently rising motif and a sense of open air. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A smooth and groovy instrumental track with a clean electric guitar melody, supported by a walking bass line, light drums, and a mix of synth pads, piano, and brass. It has a relaxed, jazzy-funk feel.
description.zh: 一首流畅而富有律动的纯音乐，以清澈的电吉他旋律为主，配以行走的贝斯线、轻快的鼓点，以及合成器铺底、钢琴和铜管乐器。整体感觉轻松、爵士放克。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
